Nearest Kickoff

Affiliate disclosure

Last updated 23 November 2026

As things stand today

Nearest Kickoff carries no advertising, no sponsored placements and no affiliate links. Nothing on the map is there because someone paid for it to be, and nothing is ranked, hidden or promoted for money.

The one way the site can earn anything is voluntary: there is a Buy me a coffee link in the footer. It is a tip jar, not a paywall — nothing here is behind it, nothing is withheld without it, and whether anyone uses it has no effect on what the map shows. Payment is handled entirely by Buy Me a Coffee; this site never sees your card details and takes no payment itself.

When you add ticket links, delete the section above and publish the one below. Both the disclosure and the privacy policy have to change on the same day the first affiliate link goes live — an affiliate link that is not disclosed is a problem under EU and UK consumer law and under most affiliate programmes' own terms. Affiliate links also set third-party cookies, which is what brings a consent banner into scope: the current privacy policy says the site sets none, and that claim stops being true.

Why this page exists even now

Because the honest answer to "how does this make money?" is currently "it does not", and that is worth saying plainly rather than leaving you to wonder. If that changes, this page changes first.
